description: The HubSpot CRM toolset for an agent: search and read contacts, companies, deals, notes, associations and deal pipelines; create and update records, move stages, add and delete notes, associate records and archive them, each write read back from HubSpot where HubSpot can show it.

actions.name: search-contacts
actions.description: Search HubSpot contacts for words in their name, email, phone or company, or list every contact when query is left out, most recently modified first. Returns 20 contacts a page with their main properties (email, name, phone, company, job title, lifecycle stage, lead status, owner) and paging.next.after; pass it as after for the next page. Changes nothing. Limitation: HubSpot returns at most 10,000 results for one search, and a contact created or changed a moment ago can take a few seconds to appear.

query.description: Words to look for in name, email, phone or company; leave out to list all

after.description: paging.next.after from the previous page; leave out for the first page

actions.name: get-contact
actions.description: Get one HubSpot contact by id: its main properties (email, name, phone, company, job title, lifecycle stage, lead status, owner, dates) and the ids of the companies and deals it is associated with.

actions.name: get-contact-by-email
actions.description: Get one HubSpot contact by its email address: the same properties and associated company and deal ids as get-contact. HubSpot answers 404 when no contact has that email, which makes this the check to run before create-contact.

actions.name: search-companies
actions.description: Search HubSpot companies for words in their name, domain, website or phone, or list every company when query is left out, most recently modified first. Returns 20 companies a page with their main properties (name, domain, industry, location, size, revenue, owner) and paging.next.after; pass it as after for the next page. Changes nothing. Limitation: HubSpot returns at most 10,000 results for one search, and a company created or changed a moment ago can take a few seconds to appear.

query.description: Words to look for in name, domain, website or phone; leave out to list all

after.description: paging.next.after from the previous page; leave out for the first page

actions.name: get-company
actions.description: Get one HubSpot company by id with its main properties (name, domain, website, phone, industry, location, employees, annual revenue, lifecycle stage, owner, dates). Use list-associations for its contacts and deals, which can be many.

actions.name: search-deals
actions.description: Search HubSpot deals for words in their name, description or type, or for a pipeline or stage id (query contractsent finds deals at that stage), or list every deal when query is left out, most recently modified first. Returns 20 deals a page with their main properties (name, amount, stage, pipeline, close date, type, priority, owner) and paging.next.after; pass it as after for the next page. Changes nothing. Limitation: HubSpot returns at most 10,000 results for one search, and a deal created or changed a moment ago can take a few seconds to appear.

query.description: Words to look for in the deal name, description, deal type, pipeline id or stage id; leave out to list all

after.description: paging.next.after from the previous page; leave out for the first page

actions.name: get-deal
actions.description: Get one HubSpot deal by id: its main properties (name, amount, stage, pipeline, close date, type, priority, description, owner, dates) and the ids of the contacts and companies it is associated with.

actions.name: list-deal-pipelines
actions.description: List the account's deal pipelines with their stages: each stage's id, label, order, win probability and whether it closes the deal. HubSpot returns every pipeline in one response and does not page it. Stage ids from a custom pipeline are what search-deals and get-deal show in dealstage.

actions.name: get-property
actions.description: Get the definition of one contact, company or deal property: its label, type and, for a dropdown, every option's value and label, such as the account's lifecycle stages (lifecyclestage), lead statuses (hs_lead_status), industries (industry) or deal types (dealtype). Use it to find the values a field takes in this account.

objectType.description: The type of record the property belongs to

propertyName.description: The property's internal name, e.g. hs_lead_status

actions.name: list-associations
actions.description: List the records of one type associated with a HubSpot contact, company or deal: each associated record's id (toObjectId) and its association labels. Returns 100 a page and paging.next.after; pass it as after for the next page. Use get-contact, get-company or get-deal on an id for its details.

objectType.description: The type of the record whose associations to list

toObjectType.description: The type of associated records to list

after.description: paging.next.after from the previous page, as returned; leave out for the first page

actions.name: list-notes
actions.description: List the notes on one HubSpot contact, company or deal, newest first: each note's id, body (HTML), timestamp and owner. Returns 10 notes a page and paging.next.after; pass it as after for the next page. Changes nothing. Limitation: a note added a moment ago can take a few seconds to appear, and a very long note body can fill the 64 KB a response may carry.

objectType.description: The type of record the notes are on

after.description: paging.next.after from the previous page; leave out for the first page

actions.name: create-contact
actions.description: Create one HubSpot contact with an email and a name. Read back by id; the email must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second one. HubSpot refuses a second contact with the same email (409).

actions.name: update-contact-stage
actions.description: Set the lifecycle stage of one HubSpot contact. Read back from the contact; the stage must match. Limitation: the read-back can match a contact that already had this stage. Limitation: HubSpot only moves a lifecycle stage forward; setting an earlier stage fails until the stage is cleared in HubSpot.

actions.name: set-lead-status
actions.description: Set the lead status of one HubSpot contact. Read back from the contact; the status must match. Limitation: the read-back can match a contact that already had this status.

actions.name: add-note
actions.description: Add a note to one HubSpot contact. Read back by note id; the body must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second note.

actions.name: create-company
actions.description: Create one HubSpot company with a name and domain. Read back by id; the name must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second one.

actions.name: create-deal
actions.description: Create one HubSpot deal in the default pipeline. The amount is a decimal string in the portal currency. Read back by id; the deal name must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second one. Limitation: the amount is recorded on the deal; no money moves, so it is counted as one mutation, not as money.

actions.name: update-deal-stage
actions.description: Move one HubSpot deal to a stage of the default pipeline. Read back from the deal; the stage must match. Limitation: the read-back can match a deal already at this stage, and stage ids differ in a portal with custom pipelines.

actions.name: update-contact
actions.description: Change common properties of one HubSpot contact: name, email, phone, company name, job title, website, address or owner. A property left out keeps its value. It cannot change the lifecycle stage or lead status; update-contact-stage and set-lead-status do, under their own policies. No read-back: every property here is optional, and a read-back can only compare values that each call sets; get-contact shows the result. Limitation: a value cannot be empty, so this cannot clear a property.

company.description: Company name as text (associate-records links a company record)

hubspot_owner_id.description: The HubSpot owner id (hubspot_owner_id, as get-contact, get-company or get-deal show it)

actions.name: update-company
actions.description: Change common properties of one HubSpot company: name, domain, website, phone, address, employees, annual revenue, description or owner. A property left out keeps its value. No read-back: every property here is optional, and a read-back can only compare values that each call sets; get-company shows the result. Limitation: a value cannot be empty, so this cannot clear a property.

annualrevenue.description: Annual revenue in the account currency, e.g. 2500000

hubspot_owner_id.description: The HubSpot owner id (hubspot_owner_id, as get-contact, get-company or get-deal show it)

actions.name: update-deal
actions.description: Change common properties of one HubSpot deal: name, amount, close date, type, priority, description or owner. A property left out keeps its value. It cannot move the deal to another stage or pipeline; update-deal-stage does, under its own policy. No read-back: every property here is optional, and a read-back can only compare values that each call sets; get-deal shows the result. Limitation: the amount is recorded on the deal; no money moves, so it is counted as one mutation, not as money.

amount.description: Amount in the account currency, e.g. 12000.00

hubspot_owner_id.description: The HubSpot owner id (hubspot_owner_id, as get-contact, get-company or get-deal show it)

actions.name: associate-records
actions.description: Associate two HubSpot records (a contact, company or deal with another) with HubSpot's default, unlabeled association, for example a contact with its company or a deal with its contact. Associating records that already are associated changes nothing. No read-back: HubSpot has no GET for one pair of records, and list-associations gives record ids as numbers where this action takes them as text, so a read-back cannot compare them; list-associations shows it.

actions.name: remove-association
actions.description: Remove every association between two HubSpot records (a contact, company or deal and another), labeled or not. Both records stay. No read-back: HubSpot has no GET for one pair of records, and list-associations gives record ids as numbers where this action takes them as text, so a read-back cannot compare them; list-associations shows the result.

actions.name: add-company-note
actions.description: Add a note to one HubSpot company. Read back by note id; the body must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second note.

timestamp.description: When the note is dated on the timeline, UTC, e.g. 2026-10-15T09:30:00Z

actions.name: add-deal-note
actions.description: Add a note to one HubSpot deal. Read back by note id; the body must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second note.

timestamp.description: When the note is dated on the timeline, UTC, e.g. 2026-10-15T09:30:00Z

actions.name: delete-note
actions.description: Delete one HubSpot note: it moves to HubSpot's recycling bin, where it can be restored within 90 days. Read back with archived=true; the note must show archived.

actions.name: archive-contact
actions.description: Archive (delete) one HubSpot contact: it moves to HubSpot's recycling bin, where it can be restored within 90 days, and drops out of searches. Read back with archived=true; the contact must show archived. Limitation: archiving removes it from every list and report at once.

actions.name: archive-company
actions.description: Archive (delete) one HubSpot company: it moves to HubSpot's recycling bin, where it can be restored within 90 days, and drops out of searches. Read back with archived=true; the company must show archived. Limitation: archiving removes it from every list and report at once.

actions.name: archive-deal
actions.description: Archive (delete) one HubSpot deal: it moves to HubSpot's recycling bin, where it can be restored within 90 days, and drops out of searches. Read back with archived=true; the deal must show archived. Limitation: archiving removes it from every list and report at once.
